lines.text: Your language app has never been to your job.
It teaches you: the apple is red.
Your boss says: can you cover Saturday?
It teaches you: the cat drinks milk.
Your landlord says: the boiler's broken. Again.
It teaches you: I am a boy.
Your partner's mum says: so... when's the wedding?
Borderless asks why you're learning. First.
Then every lesson is about your shift, your boiler, your future mother-in-law.
Learn the language of your life.
